results.text: [correction] chitta "keeps forgetting"/recall-decay-with-uptime root cause was NOT the frozen-centroid binary-Hamming index (my earlier diagnosis was WRONG). Real cause: the embedding endpoint is a 12h-walltime slurm job (chitta-embed); it timed out Jun 30 and every resubmit failed in 1s (embed-server.py ModuleNotFoundError: fastapi). chittad binds CHITTA_EMBED_URL once at construction (vak_ollama.hpp:28) and re-probes the dead URL forever -> empty query embeddings -> semantic lane skipped -> hybrid silently degrades to keyword+HDC. Restart "recovered" only because startup falls back to local GGUF. Decay = STEP FUNCTION at endpoint death, not gradual index rot. Also: production injection (prompt-core.sh) has NO cross-encoder, so the eval's reranker MASKS the collapse; owner-felt = --no-reranker: alive 0.666, dead-mid-life 0.508 (the prod bug), dead+failover-no-restart 0.735, current-prod GGUF 0.736 no-rr/0.833 rr. Fix (Fable, verified): FailoverYantra in chitta/src/simple_cli.cpp:1115 (lazy local-GGUF failover, zero RAM until fired) + 2s connect timeout in vak_ollama.hpp:109/131/166 -> committed cc-soul main 6be02632. Bridge fix: slurm-serve-embed.sh now clears stale URL, ensures fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic, publishes embed-server.url only after /api/tags readiness (was writing URL before launch -> poisoned endpoint file on crash) -> opencode-bridge 5b5e024. The flat-scan commit b7a5ae7 was a modest alive-path gain, NOT the 2x I claimed; failover is the load-bearing daily fix. DAM_EXACT gate reverted (field path is worst arm).
